messages.subject: building the inla-binary
parts:
this post is only for those who build the inla-binary by themself.

************************

as from today, to build the inla-binary, you EITHER have to link with
libR or libRmath.

libR give support for model 'rgeneric', and you need to define the cpp
variable INLA_LIBR

libRmath does not support model 'rgeneric' and does not require any
spesific cpp varible to be set
